subject: Mutual Action Plan: hosting & geo decision — Alder Health MAP & Evaluation Timeline
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@alderhealth.com>; Luis Garcia <luis.garcia@alderhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: hosting & geo decision — draft attached

Hi Emma / Luis —

Thanks again for yesterday's workshop. Per our conversation I've attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that maps the evaluation milestones to the hosting decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and the regional constraints you flagged (EU data residency + French region preference).

High level ask from Alder: minimize PII exposure, keep latency under 200ms for clinical inference in FR, and a predictable monthly run rate for pilots. The MAP outlines:
- Week 1–2: security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence (we can provide a scoped export)
- Week 3–4: 2-week evaluation with Hosted & Dedicated test benches (we'll provision a Dedicated pool for benchmark windows)
- Week 5: decision checkpoint to select a mode and a geofence for production

Attachments: ALD_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (MAP with owners & dates), eval-plan-hosted-vs-dedicated.pdf (test harness and metrics), security-checklist-Alder-redwood.pdf (evidence we can provide).

Can you confirm the stakeholder names for procurement and InfoSec so we can add owners, and whether the proposed FR region is mandatory for pilot or only for production?

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 415-555-0124

Evelyn —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the thorough MAP. A few quick clarifications:
1) FR region is preferred for production but not strictly required for the pilot — pilot can run in EU-WEST if it simplifies provisioning, provided we have clear migration steps.
2) InfoSec lead: Luis Garcia (cc'ed). Procurement contact is procurement@alderhealth.com (I've included them in the thread).
3) On evidence: SOC2 summary + audit report would be ideal; if you can surface token-level redaction configs and key management notes that helps.

We'll review the MAP and get back with owners by EOD. One ask: can Redwood provide a short Dedicated runbook for failover to Hosted (cost/reliability tradeoffs) to include in our internal evaluation checklist?

Emma
Director of Engineering | Alder Health

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: hosting & geo decision — draft attached

Hi Luis / Emma —

Attaching the short runbook and geofence summary as requested. Notes in brief:
- Dedicated runbook (2 pages): how we provision a Dedicated pool, failover paths to Hosted, expected RTO/RPO, and cost delta estimates for pilot scale (100–500 reqs/min).
- Geofence summary (1 page): region pinning options, KV cache locality, and recommended migration steps from EU-WEST -> FR-1 (cutover checklist).

We can provision a Dedicated test bench by Monday (2027-06-07) for a 72-hour benchmark window; Hosted bench is available immediately. Proposed evaluation metrics (we'll instrument in the harness): median tail latency, 99th latency, cost per 1K tokens, quality regression delta (BLEU-like proxy for your models), and token leakage check.

If Alder signs off on the MAP owners and the pilot window, we can lock dates and raise an internal ticket to reserve the Dedicated GPUs.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference

Attachments: dedicated-runbook-ALD-brief.pdf, geofence-summary-ALD.pdf

Thanks everyone — quick summary and next steps so we have alignment:

1) Alder confirms pilot can run in EU-WEST; FR region required for production cutover (owner: Emma).
2) Alder InfoSec needs KMS/HSM detail + retention/export policy (owner: Luis). Redwood to provide SOC2 summary and redaction config.
3) Redwood to provision Hosted bench immediately and Dedicated test bench for 2027-06-07 00:00 CEST for a 72-hour window (owner: Karthik).
4) Decision checkpoint scheduled: 2027-06-14 10:00 CEST — outcome: select mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) and confirm geofence.

I'll update ALD_MAP_v1.3.xlsx with owners/dates and share a final version by tomorrow morning. If procurement needs a formal statement of work or a draft MSA redline preview ahead of the checkpoint, let me know and we'll loop Legal/Finance.

Evelyn
